figure_title: End-to-End System Architecture of the Frozen V8 Prototype
governance_note: Frozen V8 Arm F Architecture; V9 excluded from primary pipeline.
suggested_placement: Section III: Methodology / Proposed System Architecture
publication_caption: Figure 1: Complete architectural schematic of the formally frozen V8 breast cancer diagnostic research pipeline. The pipeline ingests raw 16-bit/8-bit FFDM mammograms, applies 5x5 adaptive spatial Wiener filtering for quantum noise mottle attenuation, followed by CLAHE contrast enhancement and percentile normalization. Multi-scale candidate extraction utilizes dual-resolution U-KAN (512x512 and 768x768 streams) with deterministic top-K=3 proposal generation. Multi-scale concentric RoI crops (Local 1.2x, Medium 1.8x, Large 2.5x, Context 4.0x) alongside high-pass calcification and global patches form a 4,608-dimensional joint latent representation fed to a candidate-softmax aggregated Vision Transformer with deep MLP classification head.

figure_title: Adaptive Spatial Wiener Filtering, CLAHE Enhancement, and Dynamic Range Expansion
governance_note: Verified genuine mammogram; zero synthetic phantom substitution.

(f) Quantitative metric gains (+3.62 dB SNR, +0.67 bits entropy). (g) Cumulative intensity histograms showing full dynamic range expansion. (h) Spatial line profile transect confirming margin sharpness.

figure_title: Primary Diagnostic Performance and Probability Calibration of Frozen V8 Arm F
cohort: Locked Held-Out Test Cohort (525 scans / 235 quarantined patients)
governance_note: Strictly frozen evaluation results. 0 post-hoc threshold tuning, 0 test reruns.
suggested_placement: Section IV-C: Classification Performance of the Final V8 Model
publication_caption: Figure 5: Comprehensive held-out test evaluation of the final reported V8 model (Arm F) on 525 independent scans from 235 quarantined patients. (a) Absolute confusion matrix (TN=197, FP=113, FN=73, TP=142). (b) Row-normalized confusion matrix (Specificity: 63.55%, Sensitivity: 66.05%). (c) Empirical ROC curve achieving verified AUC = 0.6947 [95% CI: 0.6309 - 0.7474]. (d) Precision-Recall curve achieving verified PR-AUC = 0.5857 [95% CI: 0.5059 - 0.6723] against a 40.95% malignant baseline prevalence. (e) Diagnostic metric profile with 95% patient-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals (Accuracy: 64.57%, Macro-F1: 64.18%, Binary F1: 60.43%). (f) Class-disaggregated precision, recall, and F1 comparisons. (g) Posterior probability distributions. (h) 10-bin reliability diagram yielding Brier score = 0.3143 and ECE = 29.87%. (i) Calibration audit summary confirming raw logit evaluation protocol.
